description: Introducing the **2025 Honda Accord Sedan LX**, a remarkable vehicle that seamlessly combines performance, safety, and advanced technology to elevate your driving experience. Designed for those who value reliability and innovation, this sedan stands out in its class without requiring additional packages.Under the hood, the Accord LX boasts a powerful 1.5L I-4 gasoline direct injection engine, delivering an impressive 192 horsepower through a continuously variable transmission CVT. This efficient engine ensures a dynamic driving experience while helping you save on fuel, making it perfect for both daily commutes and weekend getaways.Safety is a top priority in the **2025 Honda Accord Sedan LX**, equipped with groundbreaking features that provide peace of mind on the road. The **Forward collision mitigation** system is a standout, actively monitoring traffic to prepare the vehicle and its occupants for potential impacts. Complementing this is the **Front pedestrian impact prevention** system, which diligently tracks pedestrians, helping to avoid accidents before they happen.Another innovative feature is the **Hands-on steering assist/lane centering**, acting as your co-pilot by maintaining your speed and ensuring you remain centered in your lane. This technology makes long drives less stressful, allowing you to focus on the journey ahead.For tech-savvy drivers, the **Smart device mirroring** feature enhances connectivity by integrating your smartphone with the vehicles infotainment system. BODY OVERVIEW:   The body lines are straight and honest, and the addition of a hard bed cover keeps the profile clean while adding real-world functionality. The matte finish wrap is sure to highlight imperfections such as dings/dents, etc. and defects of this kind are at a minimum. This is a truck that looks just as comfortable at a cruise in as it does at the hardware store!    PAINT CONDITION OVERVIEW:   The truck is wrapped in a matte green vinyl finish that presents well and gives the Sierra a distinctive edge. The matte green wrap gives it a purposeful, almost military-style presence that stands out without being overdone. As with any driven vehicle, minor imperfections consistent with age and use are present, but overall the wrap maintains a consistent appearance and strong visual impact. Buyers should note that there are light scratches and minor discoloration in some areas, but overall this vehicle shows well! The finish pairs nicely with the upgraded wheels and other subtle modifications.    INTERIOR CONDITION OVERVIEW:   Inside, the gray split-bench seat layout keeps things classic and practical. The cabin remains largely original in feel, with thoughtful upgrades that enhance usability without overwhelming the trucks character. A modern touchscreen stereo with Bluetooth connectivity brings the audio system into the current decade, and features such as air conditioning, cruise control, power steering, and a tilt wheel make it an easy truck to drive on the daily. The backup camera is a welcome addition for maneuvering a truck this long with confidence! Given that the interior is largely original, there are minor signs of age & wear, but it presents honestly as a well-preserved, original interior. Factory electronic fuel injection ensures dependable starts and smooth drivability. The dual exhaust system gives the truck a deep, confident tone, while the 10-bolt rear axle and HD trailering package mean its more than just a good-looking cruiserthis thing is ready to work if you want it to! Power front disc brakes provide solid stopping capability, and the suspension setup delivers the comfortable, composed ride these GMT400 trucks are known for. Those seeking a factory-stock, all-original truck may be disappointed with this vehicle.    DOES IT NEED ANYTHING?:   The truck is turn-key and ready to drive! Buyers should note that the airbag light is on, and the reverse light bulbs are not correctly installed (though they do work).
